files.name: Hiwot
files.before: [unsteady] I can breathe. I thought I would never...
files.text: [unsteady] My hands. I can feel them again. Hold on. My knees are not quite ready.
files.spokenText: [unsteady] My hands. I can feel them again. Hold on. My knees are not quite ready.

files.name: Hiwot
files.before: [impressed] He BELIEVED you. Olamide's name still opens doors. Third floor, he says. Do not touch anything.
files.text: [impressed] That worked. Olamide's name got us in. Third floor. Keep your hands to yourself; he is still watching.
files.spokenText: [impressed] That worked. The mage's name got us in. Third floor. Keep your hands to yourself; he is still watching.

files.name: Hiwot
files.text: [quick] Watch my knife. I am going round him.
files.spokenText: [quick] Watch my knife. I am going round him.

files.name: Desmond
files.before: [sing-song] You hear that, Winston? We have friends now. — No worry yourself, {target}. I bite only the ones you tell me to.
files.text: [sing-song] You hear that, Winston? We have friends now. Stay close, {target}. I'll keep the fire off you.
files.spokenText: [sing-song] You hear that? We have friends now. Stay close. I'll keep the fire off you.

files.name: Desmond
files.text: [soft] You grew up here? Show me which windows they leave open.
files.spokenText: [soft] You grew up here? Show me which windows they leave open.

files.name: Desmond
files.text: [delighted] Your turn to worry, man.
files.spokenText: [delighted] Your turn to worry, man.

files.name: Winston
files.before: [flat] Loud. Sawa — fine. The one with the horns is a sergeant; the rest look to him. Kill him first and they look to nobody.
files.text: [flat] Loud, then. The one with the horns is the sergeant. Take him first, man. He's giving the orders.
files.spokenText: [flat] Loud, then. The one with the horns is the sergeant. Take him first, man. He's giving the orders.

files.name: Winston
files.before: [flat] Doorman. Leave him to me. Everybody has a price, and his is written on his face.
files.text: [flat] Let me speak to him. He's watching our purses, man. I doubt he needs much persuading.
files.spokenText: [flat] Let me speak to him. He's watching our purses, man. I doubt he needs much persuading.

files.name: Winston
files.text: [flat] Mind the blade. It's coated.
files.spokenText: [flat] Mind the blade. It's coated.

files.name: Santiago
files.text: [earnest] Behind my shield. Stay close.
files.spokenText: [earnest] Behind my shield. Stay close.

files.name: Santiago
files.text: [strained] Flame preserve us. That was close.
files.spokenText: [strained] Flame preserve us. That was close.

files.name: Santiago
files.text: [firm] Keep back while I raise the ward.
files.spokenText: [firm] Keep back while I raise the ward.

files.name: Beau
files.text: [low] Go on. S-speak. I will watch the guards.
files.spokenText: [low] Go on. S-speak. I will watch the guards.

files.name: Beau
files.text: [steady] B-behind me. Plenty of room.
files.spokenText: [steady] B-behind me. Plenty of room.

files.name: Beau
files.text: [grunting] Sword arm free. Stand clear.
files.spokenText: [grunting] Sword arm free. Stand clear.

files.name: Delphine
files.before: [quiet] He believed it. Third floor. Don't touch anything.
files.text: [quiet] Upstairs, honey. Third floor. Leave the ornaments alone till we're past his guards.
files.spokenText: [quiet] Upstairs, honey. Third floor. Leave the ornaments alone till we're past his guards.

files.name: Delphine
files.before: [sharp] Two of 'em — and the real Hiwot was BEHIND it, {target}, you cut her — she's breathing. She's breathing. She ain't walking out of here on her own.
files.text: [sharp] Stop swinging, {target}! You caught the real girl behind it. She's breathing, but she can't walk. Give me room.
files.spokenText: [sharp] Stop swinging! You caught the real girl behind it. She's breathing, but she can't walk. Give me room.

files.name: Delphine
files.text: [calm] Easy, sugar. I've got a little healing left.
files.spokenText: [calm] Easy, sugar. I've got a little healing left.

files.name: Itsuki
files.before: [quiet] Loosing.
files.text: [quiet] Clear my shot.
files.spokenText: [quiet] Clear my shot.

files.name: Itsuki
files.text: [low] Stay below my bow.
files.spokenText: [low] Stay below my bow.

files.name: Itsuki
files.text: [precise] Wait. I have a clear line now.
files.spokenText: [precise] Wait. I have a clear line now.

files.name: Bahadır
files.text: [angry] Chains. Vallahi. We are not leaving those people down there.
files.spokenText: [angry] Chains. Vallahi. We are not leaving those people down there.

files.name: Bahadır
files.text: [booming] Stand back, canım. I need room to swing!
files.spokenText: [booming] Stand back, canım. I need room to swing!

files.name: Bahadır
files.text: [roaring] You will need more than that!
files.spokenText: [roaring] You will need more than that!

files.name: Yasemin
files.text: [precise] Morrak's blood. At the cage I could only tell something had been worshipped. Now we know whose.
files.spokenText: [precise] The murder god's blood. At the cage I could only tell something had been worshipped. Now we know whose.

files.name: Yasemin
files.text: [low] Your aura is flaring here again. Stay beside me, canım. Tell me if you feel it pulling.
files.spokenText: [low] Your aura is flaring here again. Stay beside me, canım. Tell me if you feel it pulling.

files.name: Yasemin
files.text: [dry] A little room, canım. These fans are not decorative.
files.spokenText: [dry] A little room, canım. These fans are not decorative.

files.name: Devendra
files.text: [measured] The clerks will know where the records are. Do try asking before threatening them.
files.spokenText: [measured] The clerks will know where the records are. Do try asking before threatening them.

files.name: Devendra
files.text: [disdainful] Must you stand in front of my staff?
files.spokenText: [disdainful] Must you stand in front of my staff?

files.name: Devendra
files.text: [cool] Move aside. I have a spell prepared.
files.spokenText: [cool] Move aside. I have a spell prepared.

files.name: Layla
files.before: [approving] Ruthless. Correct. The real one is breathing behind it; someone drag her out.
files.text: [approving] The double is down. Your sister was behind it; you struck her too. She still breathes. Someone carry her.
files.spokenText: [approving] The double is down. Your sister was behind it; you struck her too. She still breathes. Someone carry her.

files.name: Layla
files.before: [sharp] That is not your kin. Kill it before it kisses you.
files.text: [sharp] Stop listening to that thing. Kill it before it reaches you.
files.spokenText: [sharp] Stop listening to that thing. Kill it before it reaches you.

files.name: Layla
files.text: [cool] Stand still if you want my help.
files.spokenText: [cool] Stand still if you want my help.

files.name: Kaito
files.before: [appraising] Not bounty hunters; you walk too close together. A green sash — Wardens, then, or with Wardens. Good. Wardens cut people down for nothing. Kaito. I hunt bounties, mostly, and I was hunting a wyvern's head when the spiders took offence.
files.text: [appraising] A green sash. Wardens, or travelling with them? Good. You cut people out of webs without charging, I hope. Kaito. Bounty hunter. I came for a wyvern and found spiders instead.
files.spokenText: [appraising] A green sash. Wardens, or travelling with them? Good. You cut people out of webs without charging, I hope. Bounty hunter. I came for a wyvern and found spiders instead.

files.name: Kaito
files.before: [smiling] He believed it. Third floor. Touch nothing, he says — as if.
files.text: [smiling] Third floor. Yes, of course. I shall keep my hands where the gentleman can see them.
files.spokenText: [smiling] Third floor. Yes, of course. I shall keep my hands where the gentleman can see them.

files.name: Kaito
files.before: [smiling] Loosing, loosing — got him, and he was handsome, too. A pity.
files.text: [smiling] Got him. Handsome fellow, too. What a pity.
files.spokenText: [smiling] Got him. Handsome fellow, too. What a pity.

files.name: Wanjiru
files.text: [hard] So this is where the iron goes. Look how much of it they put on one gate.
files.spokenText: [hard] So this is where the iron goes. Look how much of it they put on one gate.

files.name: Wanjiru
files.text: [fierce] Hit the thorns. Go on.
files.spokenText: [fierce] Hit the thorns. Go on.

files.name: Wanjiru
files.text: [low] Sawa. Stay close while I cast.
files.spokenText: [low] Sawa. Stay close while I cast.

files.name: Dai Morgan
files.before: [grunting] Third floor. Don't touch anything. Good advice for a tower, that.
files.text: [grunting] Three floors up. Aye. Keep off the fittings, bach. No sense giving him a reason to call us back.
files.spokenText: [grunting] Three floors up. Aye. Keep off the fittings, bach. No sense giving him a reason to call us back.

files.name: Dai Morgan
files.text: [gravelly] Old stone below new stone. Mind the joins, bach. Water gets between them.
files.spokenText: [gravelly] Old stone below new stone. Mind the joins, bach. Water gets between them.

files.name: Dai Morgan
files.text: [calm] Hold still, bach. I'll mend that.
files.spokenText: [calm] Hold still, bach. I'll mend that.

files.name: Amara
files.text: [exact] Leave room for my second blade.
files.spokenText: [exact] Leave room for my second blade.

files.name: Amara
files.text: [steady] Keep your guard. I will take this side.
files.spokenText: [steady] Keep your guard. I will take this side.

files.name: Amara
files.text: [quiet] Watch my hands. Move when I move.
files.spokenText: [quiet] Watch my hands. Move when I move.

files.name: Hiwot
files.before: [quieter] He is dead. Tesfaye. I saw him fall. I can't believe we left him there. He should be with us.
files.text: [quieter] He is dead. Tesfaye. I saw him fall. I cannot believe we left him there. He should be with us.
files.spokenText: [quieter] He is dead. Your father. I saw him fall. I cannot believe we left him there. He should be with us.

files.name: Hiwot
files.before: [quiet] Keep your light up. I can't see where these stairs end.
files.text: [quiet] Keep your light up. I cannot see where these stairs end.
files.spokenText: [quiet] Keep your light up. I cannot see where these stairs end.

files.name: Hiwot
files.before: [small] Sanni sent us into that room. Then he told the guards we'd murdered his father. He had this planned before we ever left the city.
files.text: [small] Sanni sent us into that room. Then he told the guards we had murdered his father. He had this planned before we ever left the city.
files.spokenText: [small] The merchant sent us into that room. Then he told the guards we had murdered his father. He had this planned before we ever left the city.

files.name: Hiwot
files.before: [shocked] No. Let go of me!
files.text: [shocked] Get your hands off me! Let go!
files.spokenText: [shocked] Get your hands off me! Let go!

files.name: Hiwot
files.before: [weak] I can hear you. He has bound me to the throne. Break his hold before he can finish.
files.text: [weak] I can hear you. I am still here. He has tied me to the throne. Break his hold. Please hurry.
files.spokenText: [weak] I can hear you. I am still here. He has tied me to the throne. Break his hold. Please hurry.

files.name: Hiwot
files.before: [quiet] He’s gone. I can feel the power he took, and yours. It is holding this place open.
files.text: [quiet] He is gone. The power he stole is still here. So is yours. It is keeping this place open.
files.spokenText: [quiet] He is gone. The power he stole is still here. So is yours. It is keeping this place open.

files.name: Hiwot
files.before: [steady] If you let it all go, I can come back with you. You will lose Morrak’s blood, and any claim to his throne. If you keep it, you can take his place. I cannot come back that way.
files.text: [steady] Let all of it go and I can come with you. No more of Morrak's blood. No throne. Keep it, and you take his place. I have to stay here.
files.spokenText: [steady] Let all of it go and I can come with you. No more of the murder god's blood. No throne. Keep it, and you take his place. I have to stay here.

files.name: Hiwot
files.before: [soft] You came back for me. Let’s get out of here. Please.
files.text: [soft] You came back for me. Come on. Both of us are getting out this time.
files.spokenText: [soft] You came back for me. Come on. Both of us are getting out this time.

files.name: Hiwot
files.before: [quiet] I wanted to go home with you. I hope you remember that.
files.text: [quiet] I wanted to walk home with you. That was all. Please remember me there.
files.spokenText: [quiet] I wanted to walk home with you. That was all. Please remember me there.

files.name: Hiwot
files.before: [whispering] Doorman. I can get us past him. He will not even remember we were here.
files.text: [whispering] He has not noticed the side window. Give me a moment and we can leave him to his nap.
files.spokenText: [whispering] He has not noticed the side window. Give me a moment and we can leave him to his nap.

files.name: Kaito
files.before: [murmuring] Doorman. Big. Bored. I can talk us past him; bored men love a story, and I have several.
files.text: [murmuring] That poor man has been standing there all day. I have a story he might enjoy. Follow my lead.
files.spokenText: [murmuring] That poor man has been standing there all day. I have a story he might enjoy. Follow my lead.

files.name: Hiwot
files.before: [whispering] A clerk. Two guards. A very long list of names on his desk, and we are not on it.
files.text: [whispering] Our names are missing from that list. The clerk has two guards. Try to look expected.
files.spokenText: [whispering] Our names are missing from that list. The clerk has two guards. Try to look expected.

files.name: Delphine
files.before: [murmuring] A clerk with a list and two guards who are paid to believe him.
files.text: [murmuring] Best have your story ready, honey. Those two guards are waiting for the clerk to nod.
files.spokenText: [murmuring] Best have your story ready, honey. Those two guards are waiting for the clerk to nod.

files.name: Kaito
files.before: [murmuring] A clerk. A list. Two guards. Forgive me — I love a lobby.
files.text: [murmuring] A list at the door. How exclusive. Forgive me if I look over his shoulder.
files.spokenText: [murmuring] A list at the door. How exclusive. Forgive me if I look over his shoulder.

files.name: Dai Morgan
files.before: [gravelly] Clerk with a list. Two guards. Good stone, again. Shame.
files.text: [gravelly] Look at the stone they paid for here. Clerk's got guards, too. We'll need to get past him.
files.spokenText: [gravelly] Look at the stone they paid for here. Clerk's got guards, too. We'll need to get past him.

files.name: Hiwot
files.before: [murmuring] Left. Again. Not that one. — Through. Nobody bled. Tell Tesfaye I was paying attention.
files.text: [murmuring] Left. Left again. Step over that plate. There. All those hours watching the locks finally paid off.
files.spokenText: [murmuring] Left. Left again. Step over that plate. There. All those hours watching the locks finally paid off.

files.name: Kaito
files.before: [murmuring] Left. Left. Do not step there. — And we are through, and nobody even bled. I love being right.
files.text: [murmuring] This way. Mind your foot; that tile moves. There we are. You may applaud once we are outside.
files.spokenText: [murmuring] This way. Mind your foot; that tile moves. There we are. You may applaud once we are outside.

files.name: Kaito
files.before: [wincing] Right call, wrong result — the real Hiwot was behind it. She is breathing. I will carry her out; go.
files.text: [wincing] Wait, the girl behind it is real! She is hurt. Still breathing. I will carry her out. Go!
files.spokenText: [wincing] Wait, the girl behind it is real! She is hurt. Still breathing. I will carry her out. Go!

files.name: Delphine
files.before: [grim] That wasn't him, and you knew it before I did. It's dead. There's two more behind it wearing faces I don't know — keep moving.
files.text: [grim] You were right. That wasn't him. Two more coming, honey. I don't recognise those faces.
files.spokenText: [grim] You were right. That wasn't him. Two more coming, honey. I don't recognise those faces.

files.name: Layla
files.before: [approving] Good. You did not even let it finish. There are more behind it; kill them the same way.
files.text: [approving] You struck before it could fool you. Good. The others behind it deserve no more time.
files.spokenText: [approving] You struck before it could fool you. Good. The others behind it deserve no more time.

files.name: Kaito
files.before: [breathless] Not him — and you knew. It is down. Two more behind it, and I do not like their faces either.
files.text: [breathless] That was not him. You saw it first. Two more coming. I would rather not meet them here.
files.spokenText: [breathless] That was not him. You saw it first. Two more coming. I would rather not meet them here.

files.name: Delphine
files.before: [urgent] That ain't who it looks like. {target}. That is NOT them. It's already reaching for your throat — move!
files.text: [urgent] Back, {target}! Look at its hand. It's reaching for your throat!
files.spokenText: [urgent] Back! Look at its hand. It's reaching for your throat!

files.name: Kaito
files.before: [shouting] Not them! NOT them! It has teeth, {target}!
files.text: [shouting] Those teeth! Get back, {target}! That is not your family!
files.spokenText: [shouting] Those teeth! Get back! That is not your family!

files.name: Hiwot
files.before: [gleeful] Got his purse. And his knife. And his — never mind, keep fighting.
files.text: [gleeful] Got his knife! He is rather upset about it!
files.spokenText: [gleeful] Got his knife! He is rather upset about it!

files.name: Kaito
files.before: [light] If I die, tell the magistrate I was thinking of her.
files.text: [light] Tell the magistrate I thought of her.
files.spokenText: [light] Tell the magistrate I thought of her.

files.name: Dai Morgan
files.before: [gravelly] Wall. I'm the wall, I am.
files.text: [gravelly] Shield up. Come round me, bach.
files.spokenText: [gravelly] Shield up. Come round me, bach.

files.name: Devendra
files.before: [bored] Do kindly keep them off me; I am the expensive one.
files.text: [bored] Kindly keep them off my robes.
files.spokenText: [bored] Kindly keep them off my robes.

files.name: Hiwot
files.text: [urgent] Stay close. I can cover us with smoke.
files.spokenText: [urgent] Stay close. I can cover us with smoke.

files.name: Hiwot
files.text: [breathless] He nearly had my coat!
files.spokenText: [breathless] He nearly had my coat!

files.name: Desmond
files.text: [sing-song] Still got another spell for you.
files.spokenText: [sing-song] Still got another spell for you.

files.name: Desmond
files.text: [bright] Ah, you saw the wand. Clever boy.
files.spokenText: [bright] Ah, you saw the wand. Clever boy.

files.name: Winston
files.text: [low] Keep him busy. I need a moment.
files.spokenText: [low] Keep him busy. I need a moment.

files.name: Winston
files.text: [dry] Still working, man.
files.spokenText: [dry] Still working, man.

files.name: Beau
files.text: [firm] N-no. You stay on that side.
files.spokenText: [firm] N-no. You stay on that side.

files.name: Delphine
files.text: [sharp] Let them come. Mind the thorns.
files.spokenText: [sharp] Let them come. Mind the thorns.

files.name: Delphine
files.text: [dry] That staff is harder than it looks, honey.
files.spokenText: [dry] That staff is harder than it looks, honey.

files.name: Itsuki
files.text: [quiet] I can keep shooting. Go.
files.spokenText: [quiet] I can keep shooting. Go.

files.name: Bahadır
files.text: [gleeful] Ha! My turn!
files.spokenText: [gleeful] Ha! My turn!

files.name: Yasemin
files.text: [cool] Stop moving. I am trying to freeze you.
files.spokenText: [cool] Stop moving. I am trying to freeze you.

files.name: Yasemin
files.text: [quiet] Watch their feet.
files.spokenText: [quiet] Watch their feet.

files.name: Devendra
files.text: [irritated] This is taking far too long.
files.spokenText: [irritated] This is taking far too long.

files.name: Layla
files.text: [contemptuous] By the deep. You call that a threat?
files.spokenText: [contemptuous] By the deep. You call that a threat?

files.name: Layla
files.text: [dry] Keep fighting. I have not finished casting.
files.spokenText: [dry] Keep fighting. I have not finished casting.

files.name: Kaito
files.text: [cheerful] Excuse me. Coming round with a knife.
files.spokenText: [cheerful] Excuse me. Coming round with a knife.

files.name: Kaito
files.text: [quick] Duck, please. Bowstring is drawn.
files.spokenText: [quick] Duck, please. Bowstring is drawn.

files.name: Kaito
files.text: [light] The magistrate would have enjoyed that.
files.spokenText: [light] The magistrate would have enjoyed that.

files.name: Wanjiru
files.text: [snarling] Eh? Still coming at me?
files.spokenText: [snarling] Eh? Still coming at me?

files.name: Dai Morgan
files.text: [grunting] Plenty of hammer left.
files.spokenText: [grunting] Plenty of hammer left.

files.name: Dai Morgan
files.text: [gravelly] There we are. Breathe, now.
files.spokenText: [gravelly] There we are. Breathe, now.

files.name: Bahadır
files.text: [booming, lowered] Low ceiling. I shall have to swing carefully. Nobody stand beside me.
files.spokenText: [booming, lowered] Low ceiling. I shall have to swing carefully. Nobody stand beside me.

files.name: Bahadır
files.text: [eager] A bandit camp? Good. Let them try shouting me off the road.
files.spokenText: [eager] A bandit camp? Good. Let them try shouting me off the road.

files.name: Bahadır
files.text: [warm] Stay where I can see you, canım. There is too much web between these trees.
files.spokenText: [warm] Stay where I can see you, canım. There is too much web between these trees.

files.name: Bahadır
files.text: [booming] A fine big gate! They can open it for us like anyone else.
files.spokenText: [booming] A fine big gate! They can open it for us like anyone else.

files.name: Bahadır
files.text: [low] So this is where they send the money. I would like to meet the men who spend it.
files.spokenText: [low] So this is where they send the money. I would like to meet the men who spend it.

files.name: Bahadır
files.text: [warm] This is your home, canım? Then we shall be decent guests. Unless they give us cause.
files.spokenText: [warm] This is your home, canım? Then we shall be decent guests. Unless they give us cause.

files.name: Bahadır
files.text: [angry] They have put your face on the walls. Let them put mine beside it.
files.spokenText: [angry] They have put your face on the walls. Let them put mine beside it.

files.name: Bahadır
files.text: [low, emphatic] I will keep quiet until you speak. Do not ask me for much longer than that.
files.spokenText: [low, emphatic] I will keep quiet until you speak. Do not ask me for much longer than that.

files.name: Bahadır
files.text: [grumbling] More stairs. Does this city have no bottom?
files.spokenText: [grumbling] More stairs. Does this city have no bottom?

files.name: Bahadır
files.text: [firm] I am with you, canım. Say when, and I will move.
files.spokenText: [firm] I am with you, canım. Say when, and I will move.

files.name: Yasemin
files.text: [dry] Damp stone. Rust. I shall be very glad to wash after this.
files.spokenText: [dry] Damp stone. Rust. I shall be very glad to wash after this.

files.name: Yasemin
files.text: [quiet] Let us find the letters before someone burns them, canım.
files.spokenText: [quiet] Let us find the letters before someone burns them, canım.

files.name: Yasemin
files.text: [dry] Mind the webs. I would rather not spend tonight cutting silk from my hair.
files.spokenText: [dry] Mind the webs. I would rather not spend tonight cutting silk from my hair.

files.name: Yasemin
files.text: [cold] They have put cages underground as well. Keep walking. I need a moment.
files.spokenText: [cold] They have put cages underground as well. Keep walking. I need a moment.

files.name: Yasemin
files.text: [dry] The guards are looking for a reason to turn us back. Give them nothing extra.
files.spokenText: [dry] The guards are looking for a reason to turn us back. Give them nothing extra.

files.name: Yasemin
files.text: [quiet] Hands off their papers until we know which ones matter. They will notice a missing ledger.
files.spokenText: [quiet] Hands off their papers until we know which ones matter. They will notice a missing ledger.

files.name: Yasemin
files.text: [dry] You know the keep. Lead on, canım. I will watch behind us.
files.spokenText: [dry] You know the keep. Lead on, canım. I will watch behind us.

files.name: Yasemin
files.text: [low] Keep your face away from the lamps. We can argue with the notices later.
files.spokenText: [low] Keep your face away from the lamps. We can argue with the notices later.

files.name: Yasemin
files.text: [quiet] Watch the steps, canım. I cannot read a broken ankle before it happens.
files.spokenText: [quiet] Watch the steps, canım. I cannot read a broken ankle before it happens.

files.name: Devendra
files.text: [disdainful] A mine. Naturally. I wore the wrong boots for this expedition.
files.spokenText: [disdainful] A mine. Naturally. I wore the wrong boots for this expedition.

files.name: Devendra
files.text: [cool] Do retrieve the correspondence before setting anything alight.
files.spokenText: [cool] Do retrieve the correspondence before setting anything alight.

files.name: Devendra
files.text: [irritated] Kindly keep the branches out of my face. I require my eyes for the spellwork.
files.spokenText: [irritated] Kindly keep the branches out of my face. I require my eyes for the spellwork.

files.name: Devendra
files.text: [cold] A wizard administering a mine. Evidently his ambitions were modest.
files.spokenText: [cold] A wizard administering a mine. Evidently his ambitions were modest.

files.name: Devendra
files.text: [satisfied] At last. Paved streets. Let us see whether they also have competent officials.
files.spokenText: [satisfied] At last. Paved streets. Let us see whether they also have competent officials.

files.name: Devendra
files.text: [cool] We have the documents. I suggest we let the keepers read them before we begin arguing.
files.spokenText: [cool] We have the documents. I suggest we let the keepers read them before we begin arguing.

files.name: Devendra
files.text: [disdainful] They have spelled your name correctly on the notices. A pity. An error might have helped us.
files.spokenText: [disdainful] They have spelled your name correctly on the notices. A pity. An error might have helped us.

files.name: Devendra
files.text: [quiet] Leave the talking to whoever has the evidence. I shall be ready if the guards object.
files.spokenText: [quiet] Leave the talking to whoever has the evidence. I shall be ready if the guards object.

files.name: Devendra
files.text: [irritated] I can provide light. I cannot make these stairs fit for civilised use.
files.spokenText: [irritated] I can provide light. I cannot make these stairs fit for civilised use.

files.name: Devendra
files.text: [cold] Keep him occupied. I would prefer to finish my casting without a sword through it.
files.spokenText: [cold] Keep him occupied. I would prefer to finish my casting without a sword through it.

files.name: Desmond
files.text: [bright] More road. Good, man. I was getting tired of sitting still.
files.spokenText: [bright] More road. Good, man. I was getting tired of sitting still.

files.name: Desmond
files.text: [sing-song] Careful where you put your hands. I like mine attached.
files.spokenText: [sing-song] Careful where you put your hands. I like mine attached.

files.name: Desmond
files.text: [gleeful] A whole camp. Think any of them will be pleased to see us?
files.spokenText: [gleeful] A whole camp. Think any of them will be pleased to see us?

files.name: Desmond
files.text: [bright] Big webs, man. I want to see what made them. From here.
files.spokenText: [bright] Big webs, man. I want to see what made them. From here.

files.name: Desmond
files.text: [delighted] Look at those gates. Somebody paid plenty to feel safe.
files.spokenText: [delighted] Look at those gates. Somebody paid plenty to feel safe.

files.name: Desmond
files.text: [soft] Fancy place, man. Keep an eye on the stairs while we talk.
files.spokenText: [soft] Fancy place, man. Keep an eye on the stairs while we talk.

files.name: Desmond
files.text: [amused] That picture does you no favours, man. Nearly walked past it.
files.spokenText: [amused] That picture does you no favours, man. Nearly walked past it.

files.name: Desmond
files.text: [hushed, delighted] All these fine clothes. I'll try not to singe yours.
files.spokenText: [hushed, delighted] All these fine clothes. I'll try not to singe yours.

files.name: Desmond
files.text: [sing-song] Down we go. Keep a little light for me, man.
files.spokenText: [sing-song] Down we go. Keep a little light for me, man.

files.name: Desmond
files.text: [quiet] No laughing now. I want to hear what he says.
files.spokenText: [quiet] No laughing now. I want to hear what he says.

files.name: Winston
files.text: [flat] Watch where you step, man. I don't want to cut you out of a web.
files.spokenText: [flat] Watch where you step, man. I don't want to cut you out of a web.

files.name: Winston
files.text: [low] Let them talk, man. We came for the records.
files.spokenText: [low] Let them talk, man. We came for the records.

files.name: Winston
files.text: [low] Let the keepers see the seals before anyone touches the papers.
files.spokenText: [low] Let the keepers see the seals before anyone touches the papers.

files.name: Winston
files.text: [flat] Don't look at the posters. People watch whoever stops to read them.
files.spokenText: [flat] Don't look at the posters. People watch whoever stops to read them.

files.name: Winston
files.text: [low] Keep the papers in reach, man. No fumbling when they call on you.
files.spokenText: [low] Keep the papers in reach, man. No fumbling when they call on you.

files.name: Winston
files.text: [flat] One at a time on the narrow steps. Keep your blade clear.
files.spokenText: [flat] One at a time on the narrow steps. Keep your blade clear.

files.name: Winston
files.text: [low] Watch his hands, man. I will watch the way behind us.
files.spokenText: [low] Watch his hands, man. I will watch the way behind us.

files.name: Wanjiru
files.text: [low] Let me see the men who signed those orders. I want them to hear what happened downstream.
files.spokenText: [low] Let me see the men who signed those orders. I want them to hear what happened downstream.

files.name: Wanjiru
files.text: [wary] These keepers had better read what we brought. I did not come here to be waved away.
files.spokenText: [wary] These keepers had better read what we brought. I did not come here to be waved away.

files.name: Wanjiru
files.text: [fierce] They call you the criminal. Eh? After what their mine did?
files.spokenText: [fierce] They call you the criminal. Eh? After what their mine did?

files.name: Wanjiru
files.text: [low] Let them hear the names from the mine. Loud enough for the back of the hall.
files.spokenText: [low] Let them hear the names from the mine. Loud enough for the back of the hall.

files.name: Wanjiru
files.text: [quiet] No roots this far down. Keep close. I do not like it here.
files.spokenText: [quiet] No roots this far down. Keep close. I do not like it here.

files.name: Wanjiru
files.text: [hard] He wants a sacrifice. He can come and try to take one.
files.spokenText: [hard] He wants a sacrifice. He can come and try to take one.

files.name: Dai Morgan
files.text: [gravelly] Keep those papers dry, bach. We brought them a long way.
files.spokenText: [gravelly] Keep those papers dry, bach. We brought them a long way.

files.name: Dai Morgan
files.text: [grim] A wanted notice. Aye. Easier than answering what's in the ledgers.
files.spokenText: [grim] A wanted notice. Aye. Easier than answering what's in the ledgers.

files.name: Dai Morgan
files.text: [quiet] Let them read the names. No one talks over that. Not while I am here.
files.spokenText: [quiet] Let them read the names. No one talks over that. Not while I am here.

files.name: Dai Morgan
files.text: [low] Deep places should be quiet. Listen to this one. Keep your shield up, bach.
files.spokenText: [low] Deep places should be quiet. Listen to this one. Keep your shield up, bach.

files.name: Beau
files.text: [quiet] G-good to be above ground. Give me a moment before we cross.
files.spokenText: [quiet] G-good to be above ground. Give me a moment before we cross.

files.name: Beau
files.text: [steady] I will keep the door clear. You find the papers.
files.spokenText: [steady] I will keep the door clear. You find the papers.

files.name: Beau
files.text: [quiet] T-this is where you grew up? We will stay close.
files.spokenText: [quiet] T-this is where you grew up? We will stay close.

files.name: Beau
files.text: [firm] L-let them look. They will have to get past my shield.
files.spokenText: [firm] L-let them look. They will have to get past my shield.

files.name: Beau
files.text: [steady] Stay behind the shield on these stairs. N-no passing.
files.spokenText: [steady] Stay behind the shield on these stairs. N-no passing.

files.name: Beau
files.text: [quiet] R-ready when you are. I am not moving away.
files.spokenText: [quiet] R-ready when you are. I am not moving away.
